text:
Hi there! 👋 Thanks for reaching out to Leafy!

You can cancel an order **free within 2 hours** of placing it. Just head to "My Orders" on the website or app and you'll be able to cancel it there.

After the 2-hour window, your order moves into our packing queue. At that point, support can *try* to intercept it before it ships, but I can't guarantee it will work. If you think you need to cancel after 2 hours have passed, feel free to reach out and we can give it a shot!

Is there anything else I can help you with? 😊
